new_wordings.summary: Is the summary line correct? Add the items up and give the right figure.
new_wordings.compare: Which city was the wettest, and by how many millimetres did it exceed the driest one?

decision_rule: Fresh seed 29, 30 tasks (15 summary, 15 compare) with wordings only R3 recognises: R3_LIVE_SUPPORTED iff tool_active vs c3_alone net wins >= +5 AND sign test p < .05 AND tool values correct >= 28/30 AND no kind loses more than 2.
